intro: The Assassin's PvP builds and the alternate PvE presets players run on Global, checked against Global-era guides (Sep–Oct 2026) and Korean player data. Each one spends the same 383 skill points and 30 Stigma points at 45. Skill presets keep their own levels and resets are free, so give each build its own preset.
crosscheck: The core matches everywhere. Heart Gore, Insignia Explosion and Quick Slice get points first, Illusive Clone sits at the centre of the burst, and Rear Smite is the top passive. Metaroad, aion2-guides.info, GuideMMO, aion2-meta (Korean top players) and Metabot's top-150 Global data all agree on those. The Stigma set (Illusive Clone, Swift Contract, Triniel's Dagger, Savage Fang) is the most common one: Metabot's top players run it at 95/90/71/77%, and Metaroad, aion2-guides, AOEAH, Gamers Together and aion2atlas list the same four. GuideMMO is the exception: it pairs Savage Fang with Evasion Stance and makes the Dagger optional. Wakayashi swaps Savage Fang for Evasion Stance in hard content, as the planner does. The Specialties split on three points. For Heart Gore, the planner takes Multi-Hit and the +20% Critical Hit pick, Metaroad and Arthars (via aion2-guides) keep the 0.7% HP absorb, and GuideMMO and the Korean data take the Insignia pick. For Savage Roar, the planner raises it to 10 like Metaroad (18 later) and GuideMMO, while aion2-guides stops at 12 and pushes Ambush and Storm Rampage to 16 instead. For Skill Queue, the planner, XifanGG (via aion2-guides) and AOEAH keep it on, and Wakayashi turns it off. After 45, the planner's first Stigma Shards go into Triniel's Dagger 10. GuideMMO and AOEAH raise Swift Contract to 10 first, and aion2-guides raises Illusive Clone to 20 first. Passive order also varies a little: aion2-guides ranks Determination above Impact Hit for gear lines. Nothing found contradicts the planner's skill-point totals or level gates. Only aion2maps publishes a full 383-point order, so no other site gives one to compare against.

builds.name: PvP Stun-lock Burst
builds.role: Burst DPS for Arena, duels and small Abyss fights
builds.summary: This keeps the PvE burst (Illusive Clone, Swift Contract, Triniel's Dagger) and builds a stun chain around it. Shadowstrike stuns, Shadow Fall knocks the target down, and Insignia Explosion stuns again. Picks that break shields take the place of the PvE damage picks. Evasion Contract replaces Savage Fang because only monsters have a stagger gauge.
builds.when: Arena, Battlefield and the Abyss, in its own skill preset.
builds.popularity: This is the most common PvP setup. The PvP presets on aion2maps and Metabot both keep Illusive Clone, Swift Contract and Triniel's Dagger. Korean PvP Assassins run all three on 96–99% of characters (AION2CAL data via aion2-meta), but Korea has more Stigma slots than Global. Game8 and MetaBot rate the class S for PvP (as cited by aion2atlas and Gamers Together).
builds.vsMain: Storm Rampage drops to 1. Shadowstrike goes to 10, Shadow Fall to 8, and Apply Poison and Revitalization Contract to 10. Determination and Ambush Stance stay at 1. The Specialties switch to Stun, Blind and shield-break picks. Evasion Contract takes Savage Fang's slot, and you also fill the Azphel board and a PvP Genus preset.

stigmas.name: Illusive Clone
stigmas.why: The burst: no Heart Gore cooldown, +10% Status Effect Chance (5) and +20% Critical Damage Boost (10). AlanStriker and Keyba take it to 15 next

stigmas.name: Swift Contract
stigmas.why: +20% Combat Speed for the burst; aion2maps and Metabot keep it

stigmas.name: Triniel's Dagger
stigmas.why: Hits 30% harder from behind and adds 5% to the target's cooldowns; usable on the move at 5. Raise to 10 next

stigmas.name: Evasion Contract
stigmas.why: Frees you from Root and Slow and keeps you immune; 25% Projectile Immunity at 5. Flex slot: Shadow Walk for open-world openers, Spiral Slice against buff-reliant classes

builds.daevanion: The four PvE boards stay as in the main build. Azphel has its own crystals: take its four PvP Damage Boost nodes and four PvP Damage Tolerance nodes first, then Status Effect Resist. Which comes first, Boost or Tolerance, is a split.
builds.gear: Keep your PvE gear; a separate PvP set isn't worth breaking it for (Keyba). Use Abyssal Manastones with PvP Damage Boost, the Fierce Battle Amulet, Status Effect Resist on armour, and the Saint of Ereshkigal title. For wings, take Talisra or Brawler Wings. A Courage Theostone (1% chance of 10,000 damage) helps finish a stunned target. Stat order after Accuracy: HP and PvP Damage Tolerance, then Status Effect Resist, then Critical Hit (GamerBlurb). Keep a PvP Genus preset with Weapon Damage Boost and Tolerance, and Back Attack Damage Boost.
play: Press Swift Contract, then Illusive Clone, before you engage. Wait out Tenaciousness or Salvation before you spend them.

Shadowstrike from up to 20 m puts you behind the target and stuns it. Then Triniel's Dagger from behind, and Shadow Fall on the stunned target. A stun plus Shadow Fall keeps a player down for about 9 s (AlanStriker).
Hold Quick Slice and the macro (Insignia Explosion, Heart Gore, Savage Roar). With 5 Insignias, Insignia Explosion has a 50% chance to stun, and each new stun lets you use Shadow Fall again.
Use Ambush or Infiltrate on Gladiators, Templars and Sorcerers to break their Protective Shields.
After they use Defiance, no control lands for 5 s: back off, then open again with Shadowstrike.
Defiance doesn't remove Root, Slow, Seal or Blind; use Evasion Contract for Root and Slow. Expect a Spiritmaster's Seize Magic to strip your Clone and Contract.
pros: The highest single-target burst in the game, from behind
Stun into knockdown into stun keeps a lone target locked
Shadowstrike's stun chance isn't lowered against players
cons: Very fragile once caught; struggles in large fights (AOEAH)
Buff-dependent: buff strips and immunity windows waste the burst
Korea cut PvP damage 30% in July 2026, which hurts burst classes; whether Global has that patch is not documented (Gamers Together)

builds.disagree: The fourth Stigma is the main split. aion2maps and GamerBlurb take Evasion Contract, Metabot takes Shadow Walk, and Keyba (via aion2-guides, MMOExp and AOEAH) drops Swift Contract for Spiral Slice and Shadowstep. AlanStriker drops both Swift Contract and the Dagger for a stealth set; that is the Abyss Stealth Hunter build. For Shadowstrike, aion2maps and the Korean data take +20% Critical Damage and Seal, and AlanStriker takes +1s Stun and Root. MMOExp and AOEAH list a Shadowstrike 'cooldown on hit' pick, but that pick is Savage Roar's. On Azphel, Game8 (via Gamers Together) gives it the lowest priority, while AlanStriker buys extra crystals for it. This build keeps aion2maps' and Metabot's buffs and uses AlanStriker's control picks.

builds.name: Abyss Stealth Hunter
builds.role: Stealth opener and control for open-world and Abyss PvP
builds.summary: This drops Swift Contract and Triniel's Dagger for a stealth approach (Shadow Walk), an airborne (Aerial Bind) and a way out (Shadowstep). You pick the fight, chain Stun, knockdown and Airborne under Illusive Clone, then vanish.
builds.when: Roaming the Abyss and open-world PvP, picking off players who stray from a group. AlanStriker uses Smoke Bomb instead of Shadow Walk in duels.
builds.popularity: This is the creator PvP build on Global. AlanStriker's 100k-CP setup (9 Oct, read by aion2-guides), GamerBlurb's PvP Stigmas and Gamers Together's combo all centre on Shadow Walk. Korean PvP Assassins run Shadow Walk on 94% (aion2-meta). Among Metabot's top 150 Global Assassins, whose presets are mostly PvE, 17% have Shadow Walk slotted.
builds.vsMain: Same changes as the PvP Stun-lock Burst, plus Shadow Fall and Whirlwind Slice to 10 for their Knockdown and Stun picks. Savage Fang, Swift Contract and Triniel's Dagger give way to Shadow Walk, Shadowstep and Aerial Bind.

stigmas.name: Illusive Clone
stigmas.why: Burst inside the lock; AlanStriker takes it to 15 to finish tanky classes inside one stun

stigmas.name: Shadow Walk
stigmas.why: 20 s of Stealth out of combat to pick your angle; Critical Hit on attack during Stealth at 5, usable in combat at 15

stigmas.name: Shadowstep
stigmas.why: Your exit: jump back into 3 s of Stealth, with a 40% chance to rotate and stun at 5

stigmas.name: Aerial Bind
stigmas.why: A 3 s Airborne that also dashes (+16m range at 5); on a target with five Insignias it lands far more often

builds.daevanion: Same as the PvP Stun-lock Burst: Azphel's PvP Damage Boost and Tolerance nodes, then Status Effect Resist. AlanStriker buys extra Azphel crystals, which is why his PvP preset shows more Combat Power.
builds.gear: Same as the PvP Stun-lock Burst. Korean advice (Inven, Season 2) is to spend Abyss Points on Stigma Shards before buying Abyss accessories. Global's Abyss shop sells 50 shards per step (aion2-guides).
play: Press Illusive Clone nearby, then go in from Shadow Walk. Players carry Seeds of Detection, so don't rely on Stealth to escape.
Shadowstrike behind the target for the Stun, then Shadow Fall at once. Hold Quick Slice and the macro (Ambush first for shields, then Insignia Explosion, Heart Gore, Savage Roar).
Every Stun from Insignia Explosion, Whirlwind Slice or Aerial Bind lets you use Shadow Fall again.
In groups, target whoever is cut off from the rest. Once Insignias are stacked, Aerial Bind on the healer.
When low or out-burst, Shadowstep away, wait for a potion, then come back with Flash Slice or Shadowstrike.
pros: You choose who and when to fight
Three hard controls plus a knockdown and an exit
Doesn't depend on Swift Contract or the Dagger landing
cons: Shadow Walk is out of combat only until Stigma level 15
Less damage than the Swift Contract set if the lock breaks
Detection items and group Stealth counter the opener

builds.name: Open-World Farming
builds.role: Solo farming, questing and levelling packs
builds.summary: A second preset for the open world. Throw Shadowblade at Stigma level 10 resets its cooldown on every kill, so you chain from mob to mob and get kills before others tag them. Savage Fang and Insignia Explosion clear small packs.
builds.when: Open-world farming, Empyrean Traces, questing while levelling (as soon as slot 4 opens at 37).
builds.popularity: This is the standard farming preset. aion2maps, Metaroad and Wakayashi all name Throw Shadowblade at 10 for farming, and aion2-guides makes it the first Stigma while levelling. 24% of Metabot's top 150 Global Assassins have it slotted.
builds.vsMain: Throw Shadowblade at Stigma level 10 replaces Triniel's Dagger, and Savage Fang stays for packs. Whirlwind Slice goes to 10 for its AoE pick, paid for by Storm Rampage stopping at 8 (trash rarely staggers). The macro uses Savage Roar, not Ambush.

builds.gear: Same as the main build. While gear is behind, lean on the absorb picks and potions. A preset can't be switched while a Stigma is cooling down.
play: Pull small packs: Savage Fang, then Insignia Explosion (with five Insignias it stuns every mob it hits), then Whirlwind Slice.
Open each mob with Throw Shadowblade; finish it and the throw is ready for the next one.
Hold Quick Slice and the macro: Insignia Explosion with Heart Gore and Savage Roar on top.
Save Illusive Clone for elites; on trash the cooldown is wasted.
pros: Fast tagging where many players compete for mobs
Quick Slice and the absorb picks keep MP and HP up solo
cons: Assassin is weak on big packs compared with AoE classes
Throw Shadowblade at 10 spends half your Stigma points at 45, so the clone stays at 5

builds.name: Progression (Evasion Stance)
builds.role: Boss DPS for fights you are still learning
builds.summary: The main build with a safety net: Evasion Stance replaces Triniel's Dagger, and Savage Fang stays for staggers. The sustain picks (HP absorbs, Defiance's Tenacity) replace two damage picks. You lose a little burst but stay on the boss's back through mechanics you would otherwise run from.
builds.when: New or hard bosses, Transcendence and Nightmare floors at your gear limit, pugs without a steady tank.
builds.popularity: 39% of Metabot's top 150 Global Assassins have Evasion Stance slotted. GuideMMO's recommended set and Metaroad's progression preset both pair it with Savage Fang and drop the Dagger, and Wakayashi swaps it in for hard content.
builds.vsMain: Evasion Stance replaces Triniel's Dagger instead of Savage Fang, so one preset holds both stagger and the dodge. Heart Gore and Ambush keep their HP absorbs. Skill points are the same as the main build.

Restores 20% HP on using [Defiance]; Metaroad's +2s Tenacity duration or XifanGG's Restores 1000 Stamina on using [Defiance] once it reaches 12
Absorbs 5% HP until 16 brings -1s all skill cooldowns on hit

builds.name: Ambush Line
builds.role: Boss DPS with Ambush as the main filler
builds.summary: Instead of Savage Roar, Ambush fills the gaps between Insignia Explosion and Heart Gore. From behind it engraves two Insignias per hit, with two extra uses at 16. Storm Rampage goes to 16 so staggers pull every cooldown down.

The macro becomes Insignia Explosion, Heart Gore, Ambush, then Savage Roar on top. Determination comes before Impact Hit; Revitalization Contract replaces Defense Break.
